profile.sobre_pt:
Busco atuar como Analista de Sistemas ou Desenvolvedor, agregando valor estratégico por meio da criação de soluções tecnológicas eficientes e escaláveis. Meu objetivo é impulsionar a produtividade da organização atuando em três pilares principais:

• Engenharia de Dados e Automação: Desenvolvimento de pipelines ETL escaláveis em nuvem, automação de processos com Python, integração de APIs e extração/tratamento avançado de dados estruturados (HTML, XML e JSON).

• Sistemas e Infraestrutura: Construção e manutenção de aplicações, suporte técnico especializado, gestão de infraestrutura de TI e execução de testes funcionais para garantir a estabilidade e qualidade das operações.

• Governança e Processos: Gestão eficiente de versionamento de código (Git/GitHub), aplicação de boas práticas de engenharia de software e visão analítica para garantir a segurança da informação e otimizar fluxos internos.
profile.sobre_en:
Seeking to work as a Systems Analyst or Developer, adding strategic value through the creation of efficient and scalable technological solutions. My goal is to drive organizational productivity by acting across three main pillars:

• Data Engineering & Automation: Development of scalable cloud ETL pipelines, Python process automation, API integration, and advanced extraction/treatment of structured data (HTML, XML, and JSON).

• Systems & Infrastructure: Application construction and maintenance, specialized technical support, IT infrastructure management, and execution of functional tests to ensure operational stability and quality.

• Governance & Processes: Efficient code versioning management (Git/GitHub), application of software engineering best practices, and analytical vision to ensure information security and optimize internal workflows.
profile.disponibilidade_pt:
Home Office, Híbrido e Presencial
Disponibilidade Global: Com foco em eficiência escalável e inovação tecnológica, estou totalmente aberto e disponível para oportunidades internacionais — seja atuando de forma remota global ou em processos de relocalização. Pronto para integrar equipes multiculturais de ponta, agregar valor estratégico e impulsionar projetos de tecnologia de alta performance em escala global.
profile.disponibilidade_en:
Remote, Hybrid, and On-site
Global Availability: Focused on scalable efficiency and technological innovation, I am fully open and available for international opportunities—whether through global remote work or relocation. Ready to join top-tier multicultural teams, add strategic value, and drive high-performance technology projects on a global scale.

formations.description_en:
Summary of subjects seen in the course: Multidisciplinary training structured based on official school records, covering the following subjects and content: Ethics, Citizenship, and Society (study of social relations and citizenship); English (foreign language focused on technical communication and reading); Reading and Production of Texts (linguistic skills and writing); Basic Mathematics (essential mathematical fundamentals); Computational Thinking (introduction to logic and problem solving); Projects and Methods for Knowledge Production (study and research methodologies); Computer Algorithms and Programming I and II (structured logic and code development); Calculus I (limits, derivatives, and integrals); Internet and Web Fundamentals (web technologies and networks); Mathematical Fundamentals for Computing (mathematics applied to IT); Statistics and Probability (data analysis and probability); Data Structures (efficient data organization, trees, and graphs); Professional Computing Training (career overview); Innovation Management and Product Development (innovation and management); Object-Oriented Programming (encapsulation, inheritance, and polymorphism); Computer Systems (computer architecture and systems); Database (ERD modeling, relational queries, and SQL); Web Development (creation of responsive web applications); Software Systems Infrastructure (server and environment management); Human-Computer Interaction (user experience and interface design); Integrative Project in Computing I, II, and III (end-to-end multidisciplinary practical execution); Machine Learning Applications (artificial intelligence and machine learning models); Mobile Device Development (creation of mobile applications); Software Quality, Agile Methodologies, and Testing; Information Security (data protection policies, cryptography, and compliance); Scalable Computing (distributed systems and high performance); Software Management and Quality (metrics, processes, and quality); Strategic Business Planning (business vision and strategy); and Information Systems (corporate systems management).

formations.description:
